newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SINGAPORE BUNKER FINAL REPORT AND PRICES - AUG 8.
newsitem.headline: SINGAPORE BUNKER FINAL REPORT AND PRICES - AUG 8.

text.p: (DELIVERED U.S.$/TONNE) 380 CST 180 CST MDO GAS OIL

COMMENTS - The Singapore bunker market was steady as cargo prices edged up on buying interest from a Middle East trader despite offers from majors. Bunker seller were also optimistic of higher demand due to the closure of South Korean ports as typhoon Tina hits its shores. An independent sold 380-cst lots at $105.00 per tonne and a major sold 180-cst at $109.00 per tonne.
